(Maritime)

matters.title: Ordinance: (a) Approve and Authorize (i) the Executive Director to Execute Amendments to the Non-Exclusive Preferential Assignment Agreements with SSA Terminals, LLC and SSA Terminals (Oakland), LLC (SSAT) for the Oakland International Container Terminal (Berths 55-60) to Sell to SSAT Seven Ship-to-Shore Cranes and Associated Spare Parts at a Price of $20,541,650; (ii) the Executive Director to Execute the Third Amended and Restated Agreement Regarding Combined Compensation, to be Incorporated into the Aforementioned Amendments; (iii) the Executive Director and Chief Financial Officer to Execute the Partial Defeasance or Redemption of Certain 2017 Series D, 2021 Series H, and 2020 Series R Bonds, Approve an Escrow Agreement in Connection Therewith, and Take all Necessary Actions Related Thereto; (iv) the Waiver of Late Fees incurred by SSAT Totaling Approximately $288,817; and (v) the termination of the Subassignment from SSA Terminals, LLC to SSA Terminals (Oakland), LLC; and (b) Find that the Proposed Action is Exempt Under the California Environmental Quality Act (Maritime)
